entities.name: Post-Emancipation Planter Control
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Despite formal freedom, the planter class retained ownership of virtually all land on the densely populated island, forcing freed people into continued plantation labor under exploitative conditions. The 1876 Confederation Crisis saw violent resistance to proposed political union with other islands.
